verdict.rationale: Rippling documents custom workflows that automate administrative tasks, such as triggered reminders and event-based alerts across integrated apps. It also supports running payroll on a flexible schedule and recurring pay types. However, none of the evidence shows that users can schedule arbitrary workflows or jobs to run on a recurring basis; the workflows described are trigger-based, and the recurring items are payroll-specific. Missing for 10: explicit time-based or recurring scheduling of custom workflows, cron-style or API-driven job scheduling, AI-native or programmatic scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
